upstream_contract.field_name_warning: The new field is taxonomy.alternates (plural); legacy categories.alternate is singular.

bounded_data_probe.method: DuckDB read of the first 1000000 rows returned by the public July Places Parquet glob; bounded compatibility probe, not a random or geography-balanced sample
interpretation: taxonomy is not yet a mechanically equivalent row-for-row replacement in this bounded sample
a third of sampled primary labels changed, so the static prominence tables require recalibration
legacy alternate categories currently carry signal that taxonomy.alternates did not carry in this sample
the new taxonomy hierarchy carries generalization terms such as restaurant and must be evaluated as searchable category evidence

current_repository_dependency.inventory: scripts/places_inventory_v1.py requires categories.primary and categories.alternate and does not project taxonomy
current_repository_dependency.projection: scripts/project_places_construction_v1.py displays categories.primary with basic_category only as an empty-value fallback and computes prominence from legacy primary/alternate
current_repository_dependency.prior: scripts/places_type_prior_v1.py is calibrated to legacy labels and does not consume taxonomy.hierarchy
current_repository_dependency.serving: the construction transform stores and tokenizes one flattened category string
current_repository_dependency.non_authoritative_extract: scripts/download_places.sql reads taxonomy.primary and taxonomy.hierarchy, but this is not the strict construction-v1 projector

failure_mode.september_or_later_inventory: fail closed during schema inventory because required categories paths are absent
failure_mode.live_artifacts: unaffected; published PLHD/PLRV/PCSH artifacts are self-contained
failure_mode.current_june_evidence: remains valid for its pinned 2026-06-17.0 source and must not be rewritten

required_migration_before_post_august_so: introduce a new source-schema contract generation requiring basic_category and taxonomy.primary/hierarchy/alternates while retaining validation for the frozen legacy inventory
define display-category fallback independently from searchable category terms
recalibrate prominence against the new labels and hierarchy instead of copying the legacy table
measure generic and named everyday POIs as well as landmarks before accepting the new admission/ranking behavior
regenerate inventory, construction evidence, readiness, and control pins as a new evidence generation
decision: P0 for the next Places source upgrade to the September 2026 release or later; not a blocker for the current live June artifacts or the bounded producer-admission investigation. Do not implement a field-only rename.
